subject: a small round white kawaii cat in the style of Meow Tower with small soft triangle ear bumps on its head outline, tiny solid dark dot eyes low on its face, a tiny ω mouth, no tail, facing the camera
poses: sitting upright facing the camera: a round head merged into a round body, tiny front paws tucked together at the bottom front, eyes open
loafing like a bread loaf facing the camera: a low wide oval body with the paws tucked under so no legs show, the head sunk into the body, eyes open
curled up asleep facing the camera: a low round ball lying flat on the floor, the head resting on the body, eyes closed as tiny downward arcs, no z marks
notes: Whole-critter pose sprites, tint-ready: the whole cat is white with soft neutral grey cel shading (a lighter top, a darker lower band), no outline and tiny solid dark dot eyes. No markings, no clothes, no tail, no shadow, no z letters. Every pose is the same cat at the same scale, standing on the same floor line, mirror-symmetric where the pose allows. All fills are clean and noise-free: no grain, no dithering, no speckles. Shading is soft neutral grey steps inside the white: a lighter top, a darker lower band. The white has no grain, so a runtime tint gives clean colour with its shading intact.
